//: ZeroStart's own build settings, kept here rather than in the Vercel
dashboard so they travel with the code and cannot be confused with Zero
Club's. Zero Club is server-rendered and outputs dist/client; ZeroStart is
a plain single-page app and outputs dist. Settings in this file take
precedence over the dashboard, so the two projects cannot drift.

rewrites.//: Routing happens in the browser, so the server has no file at /tests or /campaign/<id>. Without this, those URLs 404 on refresh and every shared link is broken - the page only ever works if you arrive from the home page. Real files are still served normally: Vercel checks the filesystem before it applies a rewrite.

headers.//: Hashed filenames, so they can be cached forever and never go stale.
index.html must never be cached, or people keep running an old build after a deploy.
